critical_code_review_comments: DeferPickDialog auto-submit has no idempotency guard beyond `!busy` — if `submit()` succeeds and clears busy back to null while the dialog briefly stays open (e.g. onResolved is slow), the effect could in theory re-fire. In practice submit() calls onClose() inside the try block so this is fine, but a `useRef(false)` `hasFired` flag would make it bulletproof.

PlayerVerifyPanel uses `window.confirm` which is a blocking native dialog — acceptable for an admin tool, but inconsistent with the shadcn AlertDialog used elsewhere in the app. Worth migrating for visual consistency.
